human_tolerance.notes: Wikipedia: tolerates some urbanisation provided the water stays clean. Strict Avoider rating is a judgement.

phases.name: moult
phases.note: Wikipedia: feathers are moulted gradually between July and November; main flight feathers take 90-100 days to regrow. Breeding dates for IN are not sourced and no breeding phase is recorded.

taxonomy.note: GBIF usageKey 2475532 and ITIS TSN 554549 both Alcedo atthis (Linnaeus, 1758), accepted. Checked 2026-11-01.

external.note: iNaturalist taxon 2599 (species rank, active), eBird comkin1, NCBI 36245 via Wikidata P3151, P3444, P685.

range.note: Country list derived from Wikipedia's subspecies range sentences (Ireland, Spain, southern Norway to Romania and western Russia; northwestern Africa; southern Italy; Afghanistan, Kashmir, northern Xinjiang, Siberia; India to Japan, Mongolia, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Philippines) and filled in across the named band. GBIF country counts (occurrence search, 2026-11-01) used only as a cross-check; they include vagrants and introductions. Not a verified distribution atlas.

traits.body_plan.note: Wikipedia describes a feathered bird; vertebrate and two walking limbs are class-level facts.

traits.limb_count.note: Bird: wings not counted; two legs (schema convention).

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Wikipedia Description: flight is fast, direct and usually low over water. Only Fly is declared; the species-local program makes no walking or hopping action.

traits.nest_type.note: Wikipedia Breeding: nest in a burrow excavated in a riverbank, or a quarry or cutting.

traits.perching.note: Wikipedia Feeding: hunts from a perch 1-2 m above the water.

traits.mass_kg.note: EltonTraits BirdFuncDat.txt, SpecID 1546: BodyMass-Value 31.09 g, source Dunning08 (CRC Handbook of Avian Body Masses). Wikipedia gives 34-46 g for adults; the two differ and the EltonTraits point value is used as the single-source mean.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Not a published mean. Wikipedia Survival: only about a quarter of young survive to breed the following year, and only about a quarter of adults survive from one breeding season to the next. Under a constant annual survival s = 0.25, mean lifespan from birth is 1/(1-s) = 1.33 years, recorded as 1.3. The 21-year oldest record is a maximum and is not used. ADW's 'average lifespan 7 years' was not used: it is from a CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 source and conflicts with the survival figures above.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 30 -> invertebrate 0.3; Diet-Vfish 70 -> fish 0.7 (percent divided by 100). Wikipedia: about 60% of food items are fish; 97% of Central European diet was fish, so fish share is likely higher in some populations.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia Breeding: solitary for most of the year, pairs form in autumn; group_size 1-2 is a summary.

traits.activity_pattern.note: EltonTraits Nocturnal = 0 (diurnal). Wikipedia describes daytime perch-and-dive feeding.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: flees, flight is the main response (Wikipedia Description and Behaviour).

habitat.note: EltonTraits ForStrat-watbelowsurf 100 (feeding stratum water below surface); Wikipedia: hunts from a perch 1-2 m above water, roosts alone in heavy cover, territories along rivers and lakes. Resource weights and the water hard requirement (100 m) are authored.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: tolerates some urbanisation provided the water remains clean. Urban affinity and light values are judgement.

seasonal.note: Wikipedia: resident where winters are mild, but northern populations migrate after breeding. No sourced winter fraction or migration dates, so the record is year-round and migration is not modelled.

seasonal.phases.note: Wikipedia Description: moult July to November. No breeding dates for India.

activity.note: Monthly curve from tools/fetch_activity.py; see activity.regions[].sources.

behavior.note: Species-local bt-perch-sally-kingfisher-v1 in behavior.json: perch, fly to fish, eat, roost in cover at night, flee by flight. Adapted from the perch-and-sally program of tyrannus-forficatus. Dive mechanics are not modelled; see behavior.json description and PR limitations. Parameters are judgement.

vocalizations.note: Wikipedia Description: the common kingfisher has no song. Flight call is a short sharp whistle; not wired to a behaviour branch, so the program is silent.

look.note: judgement: blue upperparts, rufous underparts, white throat and red legs from Wikipedia Description; block proportions are authored.
